stem: How is the relationship between the characters in the poem “A Wave of a Day” DIFFERENT from the relationship between the characters in the excerpt from The Last Wild Place?

options.label: A
options.text: Abby and Xavier are interested in outdoor experiences.

options.label: B

options.label: C
